notes:
1.9: the always-on server, Virtual DJ, an Android app and the first beta night's fixes.
- Always-on server (Admin tab): the iPads keep working when the DJ screen is closed.
- Taps are saved on the iPad when the Wi-Fi drops and go through when it's back.
- Virtual DJ link: song 1 / song 2 follows the real songs (pick the AutoMix deck); tap the label to correct it.
- The bar at the bottom of the iPads shows what anyone just did. Remove from tonight on the iPad.
- DJ: Message managers; every notification makes a sound; go-home requests no longer flash.
- Champagne FILL OUT LATER: the timer starts when it's filled in (START NOW).
- Managers: her whole history and log on her profile, auditions from the iPad, week / month reports, real names on reports.
- Late fees per hour from 7 PM; girls after last call by night; BACK ON skips her turn if she's up.
- Android app for phones and tablets (see the staff manual).
